name: cholupdate
expr: R1 = cholupdate(R, x); R2 = cholupdate(R, y, '-');
comment: Sig: R1 = cholupdate(R, x[, '+'|'-']). Rank-1 update / downdate of Cholesky factor; R1'*R1 = R'*R ± x*x'. Update via Golub-Van Loan 6.5.1 Givens rotations (O(n²)). Downdate via O(n³) re-chol on R'*R - x*x' (KNOWN GAP — MATLAB uses LINPACK Saunders 1972 stable O(n²) variant). Diagonal entries match MATLAB R2025b exactly on the pinned PD inputs.
